operations.title: Lab: interactive mock
operations.summary: Runs the interactive mock script on a chosen host.
operations.description: A development build's mock workflow: an input group with validation, a typed confirmation, a manual action, a plan, and a result. It changes nothing.

operations.title: Lab: long-running mock
operations.summary: Runs for a minute on a chosen host, reporting progress.
operations.description: A development build's mock workflow that reports progress for about a minute and can be cancelled after its first phase. It changes nothing.
